answers.note: This focuses the add options as opposed to option 3, but allows us a custom visual design to support anything across operating systems, as opposed to option 1. Plus, option one being native gives it a huge advantage.

I'm split here. My core requirement is that users can track their upload progress (good UX). However, this is not a strict selection. I like how we currently do it because it gets the uploaded media on the board with individual progress. However, we could also entertain something more full (such as using https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/attachment or similar) to track upload progress, such as within an upload UI flow, simply pop them when they land like option 3. Should feel streamlined either way.

This upload status addresses my previous note well about needing progress UI. However, this can be designed better, as the text is currently hard to read with the contrast right now. Maybe a darker overlay
This should be consistent across guest and host arrival experiences. Would feel weird for it to be handled differently on either.
This could use a clearer, more clean design.

This is the most visible failure option, which is important for one of our biggest potential event problems. Don't want users to have to check the cards of their uploads to ensure everything made it, very easy to miss. An upload failure should be bubbled up clearly.
It may be helpful to preview the photos before upload, just to allow guests to catch an accidental selection. Terms either need a better design or to be scrapped.
